_comment: Generated by tool/generate_levels.py (edit it there). Each level overrides the base game_config.json: 'stage' uses the same keys as a base stage (missing keys = off), 'speed' / 'size' are pointer deg/s and zone deg at the start, rising per target with speedPerTarget / sizePerTarget. Clearing a level is one star; each of its two 'goals' is another (see lib/game/star_goals.dart). A chapter opens at 'unlockStars' total stars and gives 'reward' once all its levels are cleared.

levels.title: First Lock
levels.teaches: Tap when the pointer is on the zone that matches the ball. The fuse around the ball burns down: don't let the pointer pass the zone.

levels.title: Sweet Spot
levels.teaches: The bright band inside each zone is the Perfect window. Perfects are worth 3, and in a row they raise your combo.

levels.title: Two Colors
levels.teaches: Now there are two colors. Only the one matching the ball counts.

levels.title: Slow Down
levels.teaches: Perfects fill the FOCUS button in the corner. Tap it to slow time while the meter lasts. Taps on it never count as a miss.

levels.title: Save It
levels.teaches: Focus runs out fast. Fill it again with Perfects and save it for the round that needs it.

levels.title: Tiny Targets
levels.teaches: Small zones. Slow time to land them.

levels.title: About Face
levels.teaches: REVERSE: the pointer flips direction after every hit.

levels.title: Greedy
levels.teaches: GREEDY: a thin gold-rimmed zone is worth +5. Go for it, or wait for the safe one.

levels.title: Lock Sets
levels.teaches: Clear the dots above the ball in a row for a set bonus. Power-ups ride on targets: shield, slow-mo and wide.

levels.title: Hold On
levels.teaches: HOLD: some targets are long, with a white mark at the end. Press when the pointer is in it, keep holding, and let go on the mark.

levels.title: Let Go
levels.teaches: Letting go right on the white mark is a Perfect. Too soon is a miss.

levels.title: Hold and Turn
levels.teaches: Taps and holds, with a pointer that flips. Read each target.

levels.title: Not That One
levels.teaches: NOT: the ball shows a crossed-out color. Hit any color EXCEPT that one.

levels.title: Decoys
levels.teaches: DECOYS: a wrong color sits right next to the right one. Tap a little early or late and you lose.

levels.title: Mixed Signals
levels.teaches: NOT rounds, decoys and flips together. Read the ball first.

levels.title: Carousel
levels.teaches: SPIN: the ring turns too, so zones move while the pointer moves.

levels.title: Ghosts
levels.teaches: GHOST: zones blink in and out. They always start visible: remember where they are.

levels.title: Haunted Carousel
levels.teaches: Spinning ghosts. Watch the ring, not just the pointer.

levels.title: Two at Once
levels.teaches: SPLIT: the ball is two colors. Hit the left one first, then the right one, in one lap.

levels.title: Split Decision
levels.teaches: Splits that change direction. The second color is always after the first.

levels.title: Power Play
levels.teaches: Lots of power-ups. Collect a shield and keep it to the end.

levels.title: Fever Pitch
levels.teaches: 5 Perfects in a row starts FEVER: double points and a faster pointer. A Good ends it.

levels.title: Heat Wave
levels.teaches: Every Perfect during Fever scores double. Keep it going through flips.

levels.title: Inferno
levels.teaches: Fever with decoys and holds.

levels.title: Remember
levels.teaches: BOSS: colors flash in the ball one at a time. Remember them, then hit them in that order.

levels.title: Long Memory
levels.teaches: Four colors to remember this time.

levels.title: Boss Rush
levels.teaches: A boss every other round, with NOT rounds in between.

levels.title: Chaos
levels.teaches: Everything you have learned, mixed.

levels.title: Gauntlet
levels.teaches: Longer, with a boss in the middle.

levels.title: Hue Master
levels.teaches: The final test. Three stars here means you have mastered Hue Lock.
